platforms.name: ySense
platforms.notes: One of the most reliable routers Nigerians actually receive paid surveys on. Fill your profile 100% to get more invites.

platforms.name: Timebucks
platforms.notes: Very Africa-friendly. Extras like Real Tasks (photos, traffic, search) pay well from Nigeria. Crypto payout avoids PayPal headaches.

platforms.name: Freecash
platforms.notes: Fast payouts and many survey partners. Popular with Nigerian users.

platforms.name: Triaba
platforms.notes: Global router with African panels. Smaller rewards but steady invites from Nigeria.

platforms.name: MOBROG
platforms.notes: Runs Nigeria panels from time to time. Confirm Nigeria appears in the country list at signup.

platforms.name: CashKarma
platforms.notes: Android/iOS app that accepts a wide list of countries including Nigeria.

platforms.name: GrabPoints
platforms.notes: Long-running GPT site. Some offer walls geo-limit NG, but signup is open for Nigeria.

platforms.name: OfferNation
platforms.notes: Pays well on offer walls. Accepts most countries including Nigeria.

platforms.name: Pawns.app
platforms.notes: Surveys plus passive internet-sharing income. Works from a Nigerian phone.

platforms.name: AttaPoll
platforms.notes: Survey app with active presence in Africa. Low payout, quick surveys.

platforms.name: YouGov
platforms.notes: Respected research company with an African/Nigeria panel. Pick Nigeria in the country selector at signup.

platforms.name: LifePoints
platforms.notes: Big global panel; Nigerian members report regular invites.

platforms.name: Toluna Influencers
platforms.notes: Choose Nigeria in the country selector at signup; a dedicated NG portal usually exists.

platforms.name: The Panel Station
platforms.notes: Focuses on emerging markets; Nigerian membership has historically been available.

platforms.name: Premise
platforms.notes: Get paid for local price checks and photo tasks around you. Very active in Nigerian cities.

platforms.name: Streetbees
platforms.notes: Short video/photo tasks. Nigerian availability is occasional - grab it when tasks appear.

platforms.name: Cointiply
platforms.notes: Pays only in crypto, which is convenient for Nigerians without PayPal.

platforms.name: PremioCash
platforms.notes: Built for African users. Low entry point and mobile-money payouts.

platforms.name: Survey Junkie
platforms.notes: Restricted to US, Canada and Australia. Nigeria is NOT accepted.

platforms.name: Branded Surveys
platforms.notes: US/UK/CA only. Nigeria is NOT accepted.

platforms.name: Swagbucks
platforms.notes: Country list changes but Nigeria is generally NOT accepted.

platforms.name: MyPoints
platforms.notes: US only. Nigeria is NOT accepted.

platforms.name: InboxDollars
platforms.notes: US only. Nigeria is NOT accepted.

platforms.name: Opinion Outpost
platforms.notes: US/UK/CA and a few EU markets. Nigeria is NOT accepted.

platforms.name: Ipsos i-Say
platforms.notes: Runs panels in selected countries; no Nigerian panel.

platforms.name: Prolific
platforms.notes: Pays great rates but Nigeria is not an eligible signup country.

platforms.name: Kashkick
platforms.notes: US only. Nigeria is NOT accepted.

platforms.name: American Consumer Opinion
platforms.notes: Global brand but surveys rarely target Nigeria. Treat as restricted.

platforms.name: Superpay.me
platforms.notes: Very low payout threshold. Verify Nigeria is accepted at signup - the daily checker will help.

platforms.name: Rewarding Ways
platforms.notes: Same family as Superpay.me. Dual-category status until confirmed.

platforms.name: InstaGC
platforms.notes: Some offers work internationally. Confirm NG availability at signup.

platforms.name: PaidViewpoint
platforms.notes: TraitSurveys pay small but reliably. Signups vary by country - verify NG.

platforms.name: Google Opinion Rewards
platforms.notes: Not officially available for Nigerian accounts. Install may fail in the Play Store.

platforms.name: Poll Pay
platforms.notes: Country availability varies per store region - verify from your phone.

platforms.name: Zap Surveys
platforms.notes: High minimum. NG acceptance reported inconsistently - verify.
